text:
maria: Heads up — noticed p99 jump from ~2.1s to ~3.8s after the kernel-selector rollout at 04:10. p50/p95 look unchanged. :thinking:
bench-bot: alert: p99 regression detected for service=text-gen model=rw-large time_window=04:00-05:30 alert_id=20260320-314
kevin: did we change the fallback ordering? iirc the selector tweak preferred fused-attn-v2 for <=1024 seqs and unfused otherwise
maria: correct. rollout to 40% traffic at 04:10, config: `selector.beta=fused_pref_v2`
aj: can we repro locally in the bench harness? try this command to mirror prod seq distribution:
```
python bench.py --model rw-large --kernel fused-attn-v2 --seq-dist longtail.json --concurrency 8 --n 5000
```
oliver: ran that on a dev machine for 1k requests. p95 ~0.5s, p99 ~3.7s (matches). logs show periodic long ops where kernel takes ~3.2s for a small subset of requests
sara: minimal repro snippet from oliver's run:
```
[2026-03-20T04:22:11Z] req_id=aa1 kernel=fused-attn-v2 seq=384 tokens=512 latency=0.21s
[2026-03-20T04:22:12Z] req_id=aa2 kernel=fused-attn-v2 seq=512 tokens=768 latency=3.21s  # outlier
[2026-03-20T04:22:13Z] req_id=aa3 kernel=fused-attn-v2 seq=384 tokens=512 latency=0.19s
```
maria: interesting — same kernel, same seq range, but intermittent long tail. hypothesis list: 1) kernel path has a perf cliff for certain shapes/alignments 2) KV cache interactions/evictions cause re-compute 3) occasional fallback to slow path (cuda sync or CPU copy) 4) batching edge-case causing head-of-line blocking
kevin: also check if quantization branch got enabled for fused-attn-v2 on some hosts; a mixed-precision kernel could hit slow path for certain dims
aj: quick checks I'll run now:
- enable kernel-level tracing (`RUNTIME_TRACE=1`) for a short window
- run harness with deterministic batching off/on
- force `selector.beta=stable` (pin to previous selector) and compare

bench-bot: benchmark snapshot attached: p50=0.18 p95=0.52 p99=3.82 tailiness=7.3
infra-bot: note: we have scheduled a rollback toggle in the canary playbook if p99 > 3.0 for > 15m on stable traffic

maria: triage plan (short):
1) @aj run `RUNTIME_TRACE=1` harness and collect kernel trace + kernel-version metadata (5m run)
2) @kevin check kernel build flags and quantization enablement across pool (compare fused-attn-v2 builds)
3) @oliver add a small instrument that tags telemetry with `kernel_variant` and `batch_shape` for 1h on canary
4) if repro consistent, roll selector back to stable for remainder of day and open an RFC follow-up for kernel regression isolation

kevin: quick note — if this is a rare shape causing a sync, a short-term mitigation is to clamp batch sizes for fused-attn-v2 to avoid the pathological shape
sara: running smoke test now: 2k requests, seq distribution skewed to include 7% >1024, recording kernel tags

oliver: smoke test result (10m): p99=3.68, 82% of p99 requests had kernel_variant=fused-attn-v2 and batch_shape=(3,1024)

maria: ok that's actionable — looks like a batch_shape + kernel_variant interaction. can we add a quick harness that enumerates common batch shapes and runs microbench to find the cliff?
aj: already on it. I'll generate a matrix: batch_size in [1,2,4,8] x seq in [256,384,512,768,1024,1280] and run 200 iters each. will post results in this thread

bench-bot: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) pin selector for 60m 2) increase telemetry sampling for kernel tags 3) enqueue prioritization to avoid head-of-line blocking

maria: doing a targeted roll-back to `selector=stable` now (flip at 05:05). monitoring dashboards — please watch p99 and kernel tag counts. if p99 falls below 2.5 for 15m we keep stable and open follow-up ticket

kevin: long-term: we should add a kernel-contract test in CI that runs the microbench matrix above on every kernel build to catch perf cliffs before rollout
maria: agreed. also need a selector canary policy that gates on p99 delta, not just p50/p95

aj: uploaded microbench matrix results: majority shapes fine, cliff at batch_size=3 seq=1024 with fused-attn-v2 on compute-optim build. attaching gist: https://gist.redwood/microbench-1715

maria: thanks. filing follow-up RFC: "kernel-contract-tests + selector canary SLOs" and assigning to @kevin/@aj for implementation. if anyone finds an immediate code fix for fused-attn-v2 shape handling ping me. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: roll-back complete at 05:12. p99 trending down to 1.9s after 6m

maria: closing triage for live incident. keeping thread open for RFC work and CI tests. great catch everyone. :tada:
